What gets in the way today

Limited in-house diligence

Family offices often lack a dedicated research team to verify direct startup or real-estate co-investments.

Promoter background risk

It is hard to find out whether founders have failed ventures, disputes or hidden corporate liabilities.

Pledged asset exposure

You may invest in a company whose promoter shares or main assets are already pledged to lenders.

How IncoInfo fits your workflow

  1. 1

    Check the promoters

    Search founders’ director IDs to map their active directorships, past resignations and group company holdings.

  2. 2

    Check the assets

    Review registered charges to confirm property and company assets are free of undisclosed mortgages.

  3. 3

    Keep watching

    Unlocked reports stay active for 12 months, so you see annual filings and structural changes as they happen.

What your report includes

Every report also contains the standard sections: financials, directors, shareholding, charges, compliance and related companies.

Promoter directorship network

Full history of current and past board seats held by key founders.

Asset encumbrance summary

Secured lenders, loan amounts and charge creation dates.

Compliance track record

Timeliness of annual financial statements and annual returns over a 5-year window.

Data from official company filings Secure payments Encrypted in transit

IncoInfo compiles information from public and official sources, including company registry filings (in India, our current coverage: Ministry of Corporate Affairs / Registrar of Companies), tax registrations and registered charge records. Reports are provided for reference and due diligence. They reflect each company’s filings up to its latest submission on record and are not investment, credit or legal advice. Verify material facts independently before acting on them.
